title: WestQuant Memory Discovery Lab v0.7.0

creators.name: Vesterlund, David
creators.affiliation: WestQuant, Vesterlund Ventures Holding AB, Bankeryd, Sweden

description:
WestQuant connects versioned experimental sources, typed observations, condition-matched references, quantum channels and native network simulators through executable evidence contracts. The scientific code is software version 0.7.0 at immutable source commit 2c6bb71fac1a8b6561c2dfea89d280f2866155ae. A clean reproduction on 28 October 2026 passed 109 tests and confirmed the core studies, including 359 extension JSON records and 11 random-trace arrays. This archival revision adds citation metadata and a history document while preserving the scientific code unchanged.

Original software is MIT-licensed. Experimental inputs retain their original CC BY 4.0 licenses and attribution. The companion dataset contains the new core replay and separately identified retrospective sensitivity studies.
